title: Krishnamurti and Osho
subtitle: Nine cards on two teachers of freedom, before the full lesson.

cards.headline: Two teachers, one enemy: the conditioned mind.
cards.body: Krishnamurti and Osho agreed on what binds us. They disagreed, sharply, on how to see through it. This lesson holds both without choosing for you.

cards.headline: What both say binds us
points: Thought mistaking itself for the thinker

cards.headline: Krishnamurti: no method, no guru, just look
cards.body: Choiceless awareness, the observer is the observed, relationship as a mirror. Truth is a pathless land, and any path is a detour.

cards.headline: Osho: first empty the cup, then watch
cards.body: Catharsis to throw out the repressed, witnessing to see what remains, celebration because life is not a problem. Zorba's joy and Buddha's silence in one person.

cards.headline: The case

number.label: the year the chosen World Teacher dissolved the order built around him

cards.body: Crack the case of why he walked away, and what he taught instead.

quote.text: One says the master is a hindrance. The other built a city around being one.

cards.headline: Ten situations, two answers
cards.body: Anger at work, a failed relationship, a craving, a prayer. Work out how each teacher would respond and why the answers differ.

cards.headline: What this lesson covers
cards.body: Tap any line to jump back to its card.

cards.headline: Start with the map
cards.body: Chapter 1 puts both teachers' core ideas on one map you will rebuild from memory.
